pass_a_gloss: Martyrdom named baptism; transitional chapter kept whole.
pass_b_english: Is forgiveness of sins to be had without baptism? And when, by Gospel laws, to be baptized again with water and Spirit unto forgiveness? Baptism to us is given: that of martyrdom — so it is named, as plain from 'Can ye drink the cup that I drink, or be baptized with the baptism I am baptized with?' (Mark 10:38) and 'I have a baptism to be baptized with.' (Luke 12:50)
